newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines to intensify anti-measles drive.
newsitem.headline: Philippines to intensify anti-measles drive.

text.p: Philippine President Fidel Ramos on Monday ordered an intensified campaign against measles as the death toll from an outbreak of the disease rose to 39 since the start of the year, the presidential palace said.
The health department reported that 39 children have died and 695 others have been hospitalised since the measles outbreak in Manila and surrounding areas.

"Undertake an intensive and extensive campaign against measles and other infectious diseases and include participation of other national government agencies and local government units," Ramos said in a note to Health Secretary Carmencita Reodica.
A house-to-house anti-measles vaccination drive has been launched, especially in slum areas.
Measles is an airborne viral infection marked by fever and a rash of red spots covering the body.
